edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive a Base Salary of USD 300,000 per year, payable in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices, plus benefits.
3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive without cause, the Executive shall receive a Severance Amount of USD 300,000, subject to applicable withholding.

4. NON-COMPETE. To the extent enforceable under applicable law, for six months after employment ends, the Executive shall not perform substantially similar executive services for a business that directly competes with the Company's products or services for which the Executive had material responsibility during the final twelve months of employment, within the geographic area in which the Executive performed those responsibilities.

receiver.message_back: Before I respond to Aldous Finch, please confirm whether our client is Vireo Systems or the Executive; that determines how we should counter the salary, severance, and non-compete terms.

delivered.body: Executive Employment Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc. and the Executive. 1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer. 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive the Base Salary set out below plus benefits. 3. SEVERANCE. On termination without cause the Executive receives the Severance Amount below. 4. NON-COMPETE. The Executive shall not compete for twelve months after departure.
